objectives.summary: Monitor mobile device hardware and use appropriate replacement techniques
Compare mobile accessories and connectivity options
Configure mobile network connectivity and provide application support
Compare TCP/UDP ports, protocols, and purposes
Summarize services provided by networked hosts
Compare internet connection and network types
Explain networking tools and their purposes
Summarize cable types, connectors, features, and purposes
Install and configure motherboards, CPUs, and add-on cards
Troubleshoot motherboards, RAM, CPUs, and power
Troubleshoot video, projector, and display issues

stations.name: PC Build Bay
stations.focus: Motherboards, CPU, RAM, storage, power, expansion, cooling, RAID and POST

stations.name: Cable Wall
stations.focus: Connectors, cable standards, media and technician tools

stations.name: Network Rack
stations.focus: Ports, protocols, Wi-Fi, host services, SOHO configuration and network hardware

stations.name: Mobile Clinic
stations.focus: Laptop/mobile hardware, accessories, wireless, Bluetooth, MDM and synchronization

stations.name: Display Lab
stations.focus: Display technologies, attributes, projectors and display troubleshooting

stations.name: Printer Shop
stations.focus: Laser, inkjet, thermal and impact configuration, maintenance and troubleshooting

stations.name: VM / Cloud Sandbox
stations.focus: Hypervisors, VMs, containers, VDI, cloud models and cloud characteristics

stations.name: Troubleshooting Arena
stations.focus: Mixed symptom-to-evidence-to-fix simulations across all Core 1 troubleshooting objectives

designRule: Every Core 1 objective must be mapped to at least one repeatable hands-on activity before TechOps v1 is considered Core 1 complete.
